Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the dispute is with regard to the nature of land.
He is treating the land to be commercial but the payment has been made treating the land as agricultural.

3. Learned counsel for the respondents submits that petitioner is aggrieved with the quantum of compensation amount and he has got remedy by way of appeal before the District Judge under the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962.
